q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT K.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, NUM FROM (SELECT FOLLOWEE, COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY FOLLOWEE HAVING NUM>=1 ) K ORDER BY FOLLOWER
